summary: Comprehensive UI/UX redesign plan for LISTIVO establishing the Deep Navy (#101828) and Teal (#14B8A6) B2B SaaS design system, asymmetric split hero with live interactive workspace preview, responsive Deep Navy sidebar with light (#F8FAFC) workspace canvas and mobile bottom tab bar + slide-over drawer, high-density tabular catalog views, and full preservation of authentication, owner entitlements, multi-tenant data isolation, AI tools, bulk import/export, and Meesho Chrome extension integration.
